messages:
Nina: Hey team — draft blog for Redwood Optimize is ready for internal embargo review. Target embargo Wed 11/12 10:00am PT. Need legal quickpass, hero claim check, webinar plan, and lead routing CSV. Who can take which item?
Carlos: I can do a quick numbers sanity check on the benchmark section (the "2.3x" line). Link to doc: https://docs.redwood/optimize-draft
Priya: Copy + CTAs this afternoon. Thinking: main CTA = "Try Optimize (free)", secondary = "Request a demo".
Owen: Demo ops: recommend three regional sessions, 45m + 15m Q&A, cap 60. Will draft seat map and registration logic (timezone -> slot).
Maya: I'll assemble the HubSpot import CSV mapping: email,first_name,last_name,region,product_interest,utm_campaign. Using utm_campaign=optimize_launch_nov.
Carlos: Benchmarks reference: internal run benchmark-run-113 (Nov 2025). I'll add a one-liner: "Internal eval (Nov 2025, benchmark-run-113) reports ~2.3x throughput vs baseline at ~512-token avg; methodology in appendix."
Nina: Can Legal prioritize? This is embargoed and we'd like signoff by EOD tomorrow.
LegalBot: Priority quickpass requested. ETA ~8 hours. Flag any comparative claims; include appendix link and methodology.
Priya: Added disclosure under benchmarks: "Results vary by workload; see appendix for methodology and hardware details." Also added a short quantization note.
Owen: Seat map proposal posted in doc: 9am PT (Americas), 5pm CET (EMEA), 10pm JST (APAC). I will export attendee CSV after registrations with product_interest and timezone tags.
Maya: I'll drop the CSV template in the doc in 20m and include HubSpot field names (hs_product_interest, hs_region).
Nina: Final checklist: legal signoff, Carlos benchmark sentence inserted, Owen seat map + capacity, Maya CSV template. If green, we set embargo Wed 10am PT.
Priya: I'll ping here once legal clears. :thumbsup:
